en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverfront city with elegant historic buildings along the bank, a bridge over the river, and a steep, wooded hill crowned by fortifications and towers. A prominent church tower with a bulbous dome rises among the riverside buildings. On the hillside stands a famous clock tower and other structures. Printed caption text appears at the bottom right.
